The Challenge (PRD Section 2)

Why Families Hesitate on Vocational Training

  • • Missing Local Outcome Clarity: Parents often lack trustworthy local data on realistic starting salaries, placement rates, and working conditions.
  • • Learner-Only Guidance Fails: When counselling speaks only to students and leaves parents' concerns about stability and social respect unanswered, hesitation or course dropout follows.
  • • Exaggerated Claims Eradicate Trust: Unverified promises of "100% job guarantee" create distrust when reality differs.
The Margdarshak Approach

Shared Family Decision-Making with Traceable Proof

  • ✓ Dual-Lane Joint Counselling: Dedicated visual lanes for Learner questions (skills, daily work, growth) and Parent questions (income stability, safety, course fee, respect).
  • ✓ Strict Evidence Grounding: Every numeric claim is validated against retrieved catalogue records with source dates and limitations—or marked Unavailable.
  • ✓ Human Counsellor Callback Hand-off: Whenever data is missing, outdated, or a family faces sensitive financial/personal concerns, Margdarshak escalates to a human counsellor callback.
Transparency & Evidence Model (PRD Section 9 & 13)

How We Label Every Piece of Information

We never mix verified qualification standards with sample numbers or general advice. Every card and answer carries one of these four badges:

● Verified

Official Framework / Syllabus

Directly backed by an authoritative publication (e.g., NCVET NSQF level descriptors or DGT ITI trade duration & eligibility).

▲ Estimate

Sample Centre Survey Range

Aggregated from regional training centre tracking with stated sample sizes and reporting periods; local outcomes vary.

◆ Illustrative

SIH Demonstration Data

Seeded demonstration figures used to showcase platform capabilities until live government APIs are connected.

○ Unavailable

Missing or Unreported Metric

Shown openly when placement or earnings data has not been verified for a region—never replaced with a guessed number.

How Learners & Parents Use Margdarshak in 4 Steps

1

Choose Language & Mode

Privacy, Security & Governance (PRD Section 9)

Privacy Notice & 30-Day Data Retention Policy

1. Pseudonymous Counselling Sessions: You do not need an account or phone number to use Margdarshak. Counselling sessions use a random, non-identifying session UUID.

2. Optional Family Context: Location, academic level, interests, and fee preferences are optional, include a Skip button, and are never used to infer a learner’s ability or future success.

3. Encrypted Callback Details: When you submit a Human Counsellor Callback Request, your name and phone/email are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) with your explicit consent timestamp and automatically purged after 30 days (or immediately when you click Delete My Record).

4. Administrator k-Anonymity (k ≥ 5): Scheme administrators only view aggregated counts where at least 5 queries share the same category. Raw family chat messages are never visible in the admin dashboard.

Margdarshak Mobile App • SIH26241

Install on iPhone / iPad (iOS) & Android

🍎 iOS Method 1 (Fastest) No Certificate Needed

Install via iPhone Safari (PWA)

  1. Open this app in Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap the Share button [↑] at the bottom of Safari.
  3. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
  4. Tap Add in the top-right corner. Margdarshak launches full-screen like a native iOS app!
🍎 iOS Method 2 (WebClip Profile) iOS 14 – iOS 18+

Download iOS WebClip Profile

Downloads a signed-format Apple .mobileconfig WebClip profile that adds the Margdarshak icon directly to your iPhone Home Screen.

After downloading: open Settings → Profile Downloaded → Install.

Want to sideload a native .ipa via AltStore / Sideloadly or build in Xcode?

Use the Margdarshak.ipa and Margdarshak.xcodeproj packages provided in the chat download links.
